To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Draft: Football program rundown for Monday’s admin meeting

Renee,

Here’s my rundown for Monday’s admin meeting and Dr. Pruitt’s board report.

We finished the regular season with a 31–14 win over Brookhollow on Friday, locking up second place in the region. Deshawn Pettaway had three sacks and seven tackles, and the defense held Brookhollow to 46 rushing yards in the second half. The kids voted Deshawn defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches had even met.

Tavion Hurst ran for 188 yards and two touchdowns. His long touchdown in the third quarter was a big moment, but the line deserves credit too: they pushed Brookhollow back five yards on that whole drive. That was the best I’ve seen them block all year.

We’ll host Clanton Valley in the first round of the playoffs Friday, November 13, at 7 p.m. at Ridge Field. Please let Dr. Pruitt know it’s a home game and encourage folks to come out and support the team. The gate and chain crews still need to be confirmed by Wednesday, and presale tickets start Tuesday.

The nine-week grade check is clean: all 52 players are eligible, with nobody on the ineligible list. Tonya’s Tuesday and Thursday study hall is the reason those grades are clean, and she deserves the credit. She plans to keep it going through the playoffs.

The booster club’s Boston butt sale brought in $6,240 from 208 sales, beating the $4,500 goal. The money will go toward the new sideline headsets. Thanks to Hargrove’s Meat Market for smoking the butts at cost. The playoff game will also need six more concession volunteers; the sign-up sheet is expected tomorrow.

I’ll get the bus information to you if we win and have to go on the road. Since transportation needs requests five days ahead, I’ll keep that timing in mind.

Thanks,
Coach Tillman
